name: Ponnu
body:
I posted my comments  below in LinkedIn post where I found first. https://lnkd.in/p/gdsjtQ-f
Just making comments I as read the blog!


what would be the point of submitting a paper every two weeks?

Publish or perish with quantity of publications still being used a measure of excellence . Ok you have attempts to answer this later.

LLMs can provide methods (both theoretical and practical possibilities) but at the moment only humans have needs to actually realize these into “bread and butter”.

Can LLMs extrapolate from existing knowledge? maybe ? 

Why acceleration might be desirable?

If a problem can be solved faster and there are needs for it (cancer diagnosis and treatment for example, speaking from the personal experience of losing a loved one recently) then is it not ethical to attempt it ?

Equally important is to address the widespread problem of mental health issues!

“recurrent unassisted practice” in education is important which leads to future excellence and CLM (circle learning method) is my current choice and which I am evangelizing. See short and other resources here.

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ySXLbjLJRl9tseRpCeWo0Okp6-HKFgcA/edit?usp=drivesdk&ouid=110855653182556706455&rtpof=true&sd=true

The commercial airline pilot jobs are surviving due to mostly union activities and the psychological requirements of passengers most likely not wanting to fly in a pilotless planes even if they are highly reliable! The psychological requirements might change?

Someone said governments can regulate by prohibiting “driverless “ taxis and trucks more to keep high paying jobs available for less “bookish” people. Can be extended to other industries?

Here is an even more a controversial thought from me but I can assure you that at least more than half of the world population might agree with me.
